card.name: Commas in skin-condition lists at injection sites
card.fires_on: The comma right after a skin descriptor such as tender, bruised or hard, in warnings about areas where the skin should not be injected. Weaker hits appear on other words that come just before a list or clause continues.

modes.label: Comma in skin-state list
modes.description: Comma after tender, hard or similar in a list of skin conditions to avoid when injecting.
modes.example: Do not inject into areas where the skin is tender<<,>> bruised, red, or hard.
